episodes.title: Titans
episodes.summary: Rachel Roth flees her home after a man shoots Rachel's mother in the head. In Detroit, Dick Grayson deals with his job as a police detective while moonlighting as a masked vigilante. A woman in Vienna, Kory Anders, is on the run from criminals, has the ability to shoot fire from her body, and no memory of her past life. And a teenage animal shapeshifter breaks into an electronic store.

episodes.title: Hawk and Dove
episodes.summary: Dick takes Rachel to two old friends, Hank and Dawn... who are secretly the vigilante heroes Hawk and Dove.

episodes.title: Origins
episodes.summary: Kory rescues Rachel from the Nuclear Family and takes her to the convent where Rachel was raised. Meanwhile, Dick starts to put together the pieces, and Rachel meets Gar.

episodes.title: Doom Patrol
episodes.summary: After finding Rachel in the forest, Gar takes her to where he lives: the Calder house, where three individuals badly injured in accidents and given a second chance at life dwell.

episodes.title: Together
episodes.summary: Dick tries to get a handle on the powers of his new associates. Meanwhile, the Nuclear Family get a new Father and go looking for Rachel.

episodes.title: Jason Todd
episodes.summary: Jason reveals why he visited Dick, and Dick goes on a side mission while Kory, Rachel, and Gar hole up in a Wayne safe house.

episodes.title: Asylum
episodes.summary: When the team finds out where Rachel's mother is, they go to the asylum where the organization is holding her. However, while Adamson tries to convince Rachel to join their cause, Dick, Kory, and Gar undergo "assessment".

episodes.title: Donna Troy
episodes.summary: While Dick seeks out an old friend for advice, Kory remembers more of her past while Rachel and Angela discuss their past.

episodes.title: Hank and Dawn
episodes.summary: As Dawn lies in a coma after her battle with the Nuclear Family, both she and Hank hear Rachel calling to them.

episodes.title: Koriand'r
episodes.summary: Kory, Dick, and Donna find out how Kory came to Earth. Meanwhile, Rachel makes contact with her father in a desperate attempts to save Gar.

episodes.title: Dick Grayson
episodes.summary: Dick has a family in California and a perfect life. But a crippled Jason Todd calls him back to Gotham to deal with a Batman who has snapped from one loss too many.

episodes.title: Trigon
episodes.summary: Trigon corrupts the Titans so that Rachel's heart will break... and he can fully enter the Earth dimension to spread death and destruction. Meanwhile, an old foe lurks in the shadows and considers coming out of retirement.

episodes.title: Rose
episodes.summary: Dick trains Jason, Rachel, and Gar; Hank and Dawn settle into their new life in Wyoming but her old life calls to Dawn; a one-eyed girl goes on a rampage through San Francisco; and Donna and Kory track down one metahuman while another escapes prison.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: Deathstroke recruits the first member of his new team to help him find the Titans' weaknesses and determine their strategy. Jason has issues with Dick, Donna, Hank, and Dawn return to Titans Tower, and Kory spends time with a friend from her home planet.

episodes.title: Aqualad
episodes.summary: Five years ago, the original Titans--Robin, Wonder Girl, Aqualad, Hawk, and Dove--live in Titans Tower and fight both lowlifes and super-villains like Dr. Light. Deathstroke is hired to kill one of them, while Aqualad deals with his feelings for Wonder Girl.

episodes.title: Deathstroke
episodes.summary: Deathstroke offers Robin for Rose, and the Titans are torn apart deciding what to do. Gar confirms that Rachel's powers are growing beyond her control.

episodes.title: Conner
episodes.summary: A humanoid taking the name "Conner" leaves Cadmus Laboratories with a dog, Krypto, after incapacitating the scientists who held him captive. Conner wanders the world trying to find out who he is, and the scientist who created him seeks him out and explains his origins.

episodes.title: Bruce Wayne
episodes.summary: After the battle with Deathstroke, Jason tries to come to terms with almost falling to his death. Eve and Krypto find Conner, Dick is haunted by a figure from his past, and Hank, Dawn, Donna, and Rachel are "pranked" by someone lurking in the tower.

episodes.title: Jericho
episodes.summary: In 2014, Dick attempts to get information on Deathstroke by befriending his son, Jericho. However, the Titans soon embrace Jericho as a true friend and reveal the truth to him. Slade reveals his own version of the truth to Jericho, leading to Jericho's death.

episodes.title: Atonement
episodes.summary: After Dick tells the other Titans what he did, the team goes its separate ways: Jason leaves with Rose, Hank and Dawn confront Ellis' sister, Dick goes to apologize to Jericho's mother, Rachel goes off on her own, and Gar mentors Conner when the clone wakes up.

episodes.title: Fallen
episodes.summary: After his intentional attack on two police officers results in his arrest, Dick finally finds peace in a Nevada prison. But the hero he's left behind has not been buried forever. Meanwhile, Rachel befriends a runaway girl and takes her under her wing – only to find that her own powers might not fully be under her control. Back at Titans Tower, Gar is reunited with Conner and Krypto, but when Mercy Graves sets her sights on retrieving "Subject 13" for Cadmus, Gar finds himself caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: E.L._.O.
episodes.summary: Rachel, Kory, Dawn, and Donna are summoned to a diner by a mysterious host, who tells them that they need to rescue Dick. Meanwhile, Dick suffers in prison and Gar gets Cadmus brain surgery.

episodes.title: Faux Hawk
episodes.summary: Hank battles as Hawk in an underground fight club, trying to cope with life after Dawn. Donna and Dawn track down Gar and Conner, Rose reveals her origin to Jason, and Dick gets a new suit.

episodes.title: Nightwing
episodes.summary: Nightwing leads the Titans against first Deathstroke, and then their brainwashed teammates Gar and Conner, The team then decides whether to go their separate ways, and Dick and Bruce come to an understanding.

episodes.title: Barbara Gordon
episodes.summary: Desperate to leave his mark, Jason Todd confronts the Joker once and for all. But when fatal consequences ensue, Dick Grayson is forced to step away from the Titans and return to Gotham City.

episodes.title: Red Hood
episodes.summary: With the Joker out of the picture, the mysterious Red Hood takes charge. But after bringing the Titans back to Gotham City, Dick is confronted by the city's newest villain - and his shocking real identity.

episodes.title: Hank & Dove
episodes.summary: After unearthing an empty grave, the Titans confirm that an old friend is alive - and behind the city's latest emerging threat. Then, when a Titan falls for Red Hood's trap, the team races against the clock to save one of their own.

episodes.title: Blackfire
episodes.summary: Devastated by loss, the Titans find themselves in disarray. While Dick throws himself into drawing out Red Hood with Jonathan Crane, Kory and Gar work to understand Starfire's escalating visions, leading them to a surprising source.

episodes.title: Lazarus
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of his fight with Nightwing, anti-heroes Red Hood and Jonathan Crane reteam for the first phase of their fearsome plan. Then, through a series of flashbacks, Red Hood's origins are revealed.

episodes.title: Lady Vic
episodes.summary: Crane enlists the help of lethal assassin Lady Vic, who has a troubled history with Dick and Barbara. Meanwhile, Kory and Gar bring Blackfire back to Wayne Manor.

Gotham's crime families meet to discuss the fear toxin's hold on the city - only to be confronted by the mastermind himself. As Dick and Barbara consult the Oracle to preempt Crane's next move, Starfire and Blackfire reach an understanding.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: As an emboldened Crane looks to filter his poison through Gotham's water system, Starfire - still plagued by visions - enlists Blackfire and Superboy's help, and Gar finally tracks down Jason.

episodes.title: Souls
episodes.summary: After waking up on a mysterious train, Tim Drake teams with two familiar heroes to locate an elusive bridge back to the land of the living. Meanwhile, Rachel grapples with her own powers in a desperate attempt to resurrect Donna.

episodes.title: Troubled Water
episodes.summary: Things go from bad to worse as the Titans are falsely blamed for poisoning the city, forcing them into a perilous position as they work to regain Gotham's trust.

episodes.title: The Call Is Coming from Inside the House
episodes.summary: Crane and Red Hood plan the death of Nightwing.

episodes.title: Prodigal
episodes.summary: After Nightwing and Red Hood's battle, Rachel and Gar try to save their friend. Meanwhile, Jason questions his allegiance. With Barbara behind bars, Donna leads her own resistance operation, and Conner helps Blackfire recover her ship.

episodes.title: Purple Rain
episodes.summary: With Gotham once again at the mercy of Crane's terror, it's all hands on deck for the Titans as they infiltrate Wayne Manor and harness an ancient power that transcends life and death.

episodes.title: Lex Luthor
episodes.summary: After Superman requests a meeting with Conner, the Titans travel to Metropolis for exclusive access to S.T.A.R. Labs. But when unexpected complications arise, including the re-emergence of Lex Luthor, Conner faces a tough decision.

episodes.title: Mother Mayhem
episodes.summary: In the wake of Lex Luthor's sudden demise, Conner finds himself framed for murder while the Titans try to piece together Luthor's suspicious connection to Rachel's haunting and clear their teammate's name.

episodes.title: Jinx
episodes.summary: With Rachel left powerless, Dick turns to an old friend whose magic could be the key to identifying their mysterious enemy. Meanwhile, Conner and Tim investigate attack victims, and Sebastian finds himself at the center of an eerie plot.

episodes.title: Super Super Mart
episodes.summary: As she grows closer to Sebastian, Rachel makes an unsettling discover that leads the Titans to The Organization's Asylum--where they come face-to-face with their deadliest foes yet.

episodes.title: Inside Man
episodes.summary: As the Blood Moon rises, the Titans fight to keep Sebastian from Mother Mayhem's clutches, and an injured Conner gives rise to a venomous threat that jeopardizes the team's plan.

episodes.title: Brother Blood
episodes.summary: The Titans race against time to save Sebastian before the Blood Moon ritual, while Conner's new hardened personality rears, and Gar is presented with an ominous choice.

episodes.title: Caul's Folly
episodes.summary: In the wake of Sebastian's transformation, the Titans race to retrieve Traigon's horn, leading them to the quaint – but eerie – town of Caul's Folly.

episodes.title: Dick & Carol & Ted & Kory
episodes.summary: With Dick and Kory at risk of falling victim to the spell of Caul's Folly, Bernard and Tim attempt to crack the town's mystery before it's too late.

episodes.title: Dude, Where's My Gar
episodes.summary: After being separated from the Titans, Gar uncovers long-lost secrets from his past as he confronts his mysterious connection to the Red.

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.summary: With help from Conner at Lexcorp, Sebastian manifests his powers in a sinister new way, as Dick and Rachel have a close encounter with black magic.

episodes.title: Project Starfire
episodes.summary: An unexpected reunion sheds light on Project Starfire, forcing Kory to make a difficult decision that puts her powers to the ultimate test.

episodes.title: Titans Forever
episodes.summary: With Brother Blood at full power and Conner left in critical condition, the Titans join forces to find and defeat Sebastian once and for all.
